newsitem.title: EGYPT: Pharaonic, Graeco-Roman burial site found in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Pharaonic, Graeco-Roman burial site found in Egypt.

text.p: Archaeologists have discovered an ancient burial site in Egypt's Nile delta which was used in Pharaonic and Graeco-Roman times, the official Al-Akhbar newspaper reported on Sunday.
The daily said the 25-acre (10-hectare) site was found in May in the town of Ouesnah, some 100 km (60 miles) north of Cairo, but was announced only on Saturday.
The paper said archaeologists found jewels, gold foil, sarcophagai and clay pots in the cemetry, which lies 15 metres (49 feet) beneath the surface.
Officials at the Supreme Antiquities Council were not immediately available for comment.
